messages:
Priya: Quick sync — we need to lock the run-of-show and speaker confirmations for next Wed's webinar on inference economics (cost vs latency). Goal: 35 min + 10 min live Q&A. Draft agenda below, please confirm availability and slide/demo ownership.

Diego: I can own benchmarks + demo of latency fallbacks. Need ~12m for demo including failover scenario.

Ben: I’ll do a 4-5m intro + closing CTAs. Can also pull together a one-slide TL;DR about Redwood Dedicated. :thumbsup:

Ava: I can present a short customer case (7m). Will need the sanitized telemetry by Mon to make the charts.

Priya: Draft run-of-show (times are max):
- 0:00–0:05 Ben: Welcome + why this matters (problem framing)
- 0:05–0:13 Diego: Benchmarks & narrative (cost vs latency tradeoffs)
- 0:13–0:20 Ava: Customer case study (cost reduction + SLA wins)
- 0:20–0:32 Diego: Live demo (batching, quantization, fallbacks) — include one controlled failure
- 0:32–0:42 Panel Q&A (Ben + Diego + Ava)
- 0:42–0:45 Ben: Next steps / CTA / resources link

Priya: Rehearsal windows: Fri 11:00 PT (tech run) and Mon 09:00 PT (content run). Which works? Also need slide uploads by Mon EOD.

Diego: Fri 11 works. For the demo, use staging-redwood cluster. Quick command to seed the demo env:```bash
export REDWOOD_ENV=staging
./deploy_demo.sh --model gpt-medium --cache on
```I’ll attach a minimal script in the drive.

Ava: Mon 09 content run ok for me but need Ben to share his TL;DR slide earlier so I can align callouts.

Ben: Can share TL;DR by Sunday noon. Also can do a 2-slide backup in case demo flaps.

Priya: Ops note — please add any hard requirements for SRE (extra capacity, recording, live captions) now. I'll file tickets.

Diego: Need an ephemeral extra GPU for the failure scenario — request ticket to eng-infra by Tuesday.

Priya: Got it. I’ll ping eng-infra and set priority.

Ava: Slide deck link?

Priya: Uploading to GDrive now: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link (will replace with real after upload). Please comment directly on slides where you want changes.

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: Webinar — "Inference economics: balancing cost & latency" Wed 11:00 PT. Rehearsal: Fri 11:00 PT. Recording: enabled.

Ben: :thumbsup:

Priya: Thanks all — next actions: Ben share TL;DR by Sun noon, Diego attach demo script to drive, Ava upload slides Monday EOD, Priya open eng-infra ticket. See you at Fri tech run.
